messages:
sara (sales): Heads up — FinReg wants a 10-day POC. Requirements: SSO (SAML), SCIM user provisioning, RBAC per-tenant, and domain ownership controls. Also they sent a security questionnaire. Need checklist + pricing guidance asap :eyes:

nate (solutions): Got it. Are they using Okta/Azure AD/ADFS? Also need expected user counts and any bulk-join windows so we can size burst capacity.

sara (sales): Theyre on Okta + Azure AD for different business units. Estimate: 8k active users, ~1.2k daily joins normally, but onboarding spikes could be ~20k/day for migrations.

arjun (security): Quick security constraints from our side: SAML 2.0 (signed assertions required), support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, Subject NameID should be email. We prefer Encrypted Assertions optional. For SCIM, implement SCIM v2 with OAuth Bearer token; support PATCH and bulk operations. Need webhook on provisioning errors.

emily (acct): For pricing: POC can run on hosted with rate limits, but at those spike numbers we should propose Dedicated or burst-enabled plan. Pricing model = reserved capacity + burst fees. I can draft a ballpark once we confirm peak token/req rates.

nate (solutions): POC runbook (high level):
1) Create test tenant on our infra (we'll spin one in staging)
2) Customer provides IdP metadata (XML) and test users CSV + SCIM token (scoped to provisioning)
3) Run SCIM in "dry-run" to validate attribute mapping + groups -> RBAC roles
4) Validate SAML login flows (SP & IdP) and ACS endpoints, then flip to production certs
5) Run a small bulk sync, monitor SCIM rate/latency and provisioning failure webhooks

sara (sales): Can you share a small curl example for SCIM so they can pretest?

nate (solutions): Sure — example: 
```bash
curl -X GET 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" 
  -H "Accept: application/scim+json" 
  "https://staging-infra.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users"
```
Also for PATCH (group membership): use `Content-Type: application/scim+json` and a PATCH body with `schemas: ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"]`.

arjun (security): Security questionnaire blockers to call out (they asked): SOC2 Type II status (we have it), KMS/HSM key control for customer-managed keys (we offer KMS integration for Private), audit log retention & immutable logs, IP allowlisting for admin console, MFA for admin users. Also ask: do they require SCIM delete to be hard-delete or soft-delete with retention window? That affects our retention & e-discovery answers.

emily (acct): Noted — I'll answer SOC2 + KMS bits. On billing: if they want dedicated GPU pool for model serving + high SCIM throughput during onboarding, expect uplift on monthly commit. I will prepare two bands: (a) hosted with burst, (b) dedicated small pool + burst, with example numbers.

devops-bot: tenant-staging-42 created by infra-svc — credentials emailed to you, sara.

sara (sales): Thanks — will send IdP metadata and sample users tonight. Also legal wants domain proofing details: can we support DNS TXT or SAML-based domain claim?

arjun (security): Domain proofing options: DNS TXT token is standard and fastest. We can also accept a SAML assertion with a verified email claim, but DNS is preferred for domain-level ownership (supports wildcard/subdomain proofing via delegated TXT entries). We record proof artifacts in the tenant audit log.

nate (solutions): Edge cases: if customer doesn't want SCIM, we can do CSV import + manual RBAC mapping. For unreliable SCIM endpoints we recommend enabling our retry/backoff and provisioning-failure webhook to surface errors to the customer's ops.

sara (sales): Timeline check — customer expects end-to-end POC in 10 working days. Feasible? :pray:

nate (solutions): Rough: 1 business day to provision tenant, 2 days for SAML + attribute mapping, 2 days for SCIM dry-run & bulk, 2 days for role mapping and QA. Optimistic but doable if they provide metadata/token promptly.

emily (acct): I'll draft the pricing bands and include a note on committed months required for Dedicated uplift.

arjun (security): I'll prepare a short packet answering the security questionnaire items they flagged (KMS, audit logs, retention, cert rotation cadence).

sara (sales): Great — I'll coordinate with the FinReg SRE and send the metadata + sample CSV. Will ping this thread when sent. Thanks all :thumbsup:
